title: Lattice finish manifest
description: A shipped finish PACKAGE (engineering/decisions/2026-09-23-portable-packages.md §3.3, §3.6). The manifest owns the name and the picker's presentation; the sibling <name>.recipe.json is the look in the Studio's layer vocabulary (its "Start from preset" and a saved copy). The build generates the finish's section.finish-<name> rule in lib/base/base.finish.css from that recipe (lib/finishes/finish-generate.js), so the recipe is what a deck renders. The register (lib/core/resolve-finish.js), the Studio's preset recipes and its picker catalog are all generated from these files by tools/build-packages-index.js.

name.description: The `finish:` register value. MUST equal the folder name and every file prefix (checkPackageIdentity).

blurb.description: One line under the label in the picker.

order.description: Position in the register and the picker. Unique across finishes.

swatch.description: The picker chip: a CSS background (and optional size) in accent-mix gradients only.
